actual: A current-code formal P6 run completed 2096/2096 fits and durably accepted D5 seed 43, but D6 failed at 801011.SI before selected-level construction with 'utility must contain only finite values'. D6-NA-A build_l1_training_series intentionally stores validation_future_utility as an empty legacy dense sentinel when validation_calendar_series v2 is authoritative, while L1TrainingSeries.validate unconditionally calls _finite_array before checking the carrier and rejects the valid sentinel. Fix carrier-v2 validation to use only its compact finite utility authority while preserving strict dense-v1 validation, add direct regression tests, and verify zero-refit from the durable D5 checkpoint/failure without refitting, reselection, threshold changes, semantic-authority changes, model/READY fabrication, DB writes, or runtime actions.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

expected: D6 carrier v2 validates its compact masked utility authority while the legacy dense field is a strict empty one-dimensional sentinel; dense-v1 remains finite and aligned. Zero-refit must reach typed D6 acceptance or evidence rejection without fitting or reselection.
